CommunityApplications.Profile: DockSentinel is a lightweight, self-hosted Docker vulnerability monitor. It discovers images and containers across Docker endpoints, scans images with Trivy, keeps a finding history with triage, and sends optional ntfy alerts. It only reads Docker metadata and runs Trivy against exported image archives. The template uses the public ghcr.io/luriot/docksentinel image and includes a guided first-run setup.
